Without a Qt parent the QThread's C++ object gets tied exclusively to Python's refcount — and dropping the ref while QThread.isRunning() is still True (which happens in the tiny window between worker.run returning and thread.finished firing) triggers Qt's `QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running / Aborted` crash. records.source: IMPORTANT: pass a `parent` (typically the panel that owns this stream). A parent keeps the C++ object alive until deleteLater runs.
records.translation: IMPORTANT: एक `parent` दें (आमतौर पर वह पैनल जिसके पास यह स्ट्रीम है)। Qt parent के बिना QThread का C++ ऑब्जेक्ट पूरी तरह Python के refcount पर निर्भर हो जाता है — और QThread.isRunning() के अभी भी True रहते संदर्भ छोड़ देने पर (जो worker.run लौटने और thread.finished चलने के बीच की छोटी अवधि में होता है) Qt का `QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running / Aborted` क्रैश होता है। parent होने से C++ ऑब्जेक्ट deleteLater चलने तक जीवित रहता है।

records.context: Two wiring details are load-bearing; both are the same contract :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` documents, and this function used to get them wrong:
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.worker.make_stream_thread#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Two wiring details are load-bearing; both are the same contract :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` documents, and this function used to get them wrong:
records.translation: जोड़ने के दो विवरण निर्णायक हैं; दोनों वही अनुबंध हैं जिसे :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` प्रलेखित करता है, और यह फ़ंक्शन पहले इन्हें गलत करता था:

records.context: There is deliberately **no** ``worker.deleteLater``. The worker's affinity is the background execution unit, so a deferred delete is posted into a loop that is stopping, while the panel drops the object's last Python reference from the main GUI execution path — two owners, one object. ``bridge.make_thread``'s ownership essay records the gdb trace (``QThread -> sendPostedEvents -> ~QObject -> Sbk_GetPyOverride``) and the measurement: 3 crashes in 8 executions. A PySide6 object built in Python is already owned by Python; ``ConsolePanel``/``AIChatPanel`` hold it in ``_retired`` until the independent execution path has exited and free it there, on the independent execution path that holds it.
records.label: spacr.qt.ai.worker.make_stream_thread#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: There is deliberately **no** ``worker.deleteLater``. The worker's affinity is the worker thread, so a deferred delete is posted into a loop that is stopping, while the panel drops the object's last Python reference from the GUI thread — two owners, one object. ``bridge.make_thread``'s ownership essay records the gdb trace (``QThread -> sendPostedEvents -> ~QObject -> Sbk_GetPyOverride``) and the measurement: 3 crashes in 8 runs. A PySide6 object built in Python is already owned by Python; ``ConsolePanel``/``AIChatPanel`` hold it in ``_retired`` until the thread has exited and free it there, on the thread that holds it.
records.translation: जानबूझकर **no** ``worker.deleteLater`` रखा गया है। वर्कर की affinity वर्कर थ्रेड है, इसलिए विलंबित हटाना एक ऐसे लूप में भेजा जाता है जो रुक रहा है, जबकि पैनल GUI थ्रेड से ऑब्जेक्ट का अंतिम Python संदर्भ छोड़ देता है — एक ऑब्जेक्ट, दो स्वामी। ``bridge.make_thread`` का स्वामित्व-विवरण gdb ट्रेस (``QThread -> sendPostedEvents -> ~QObject -> Sbk_GetPyOverride``) और मापन दर्ज करता है: 8 रन में 3 क्रैश। Python में बना PySide6 ऑब्जेक्ट पहले से Python के स्वामित्व में होता है; ``ConsolePanel``/``AIChatPanel`` थ्रेड के बाहर निकलने तक उसे ``_retired`` में रखते हैं और वहीं, उसे धारण करने वाले थ्रेड पर, उसे मुक्त करते हैं।

records.source: Two features need a click to mean something other than "select the object under the cursor" — drawing a polygon vertex (:mod:`spacr.qt.roi_tool`) and dropping a counted marker (:mod:`spacr.qt.counting_tool`) — and both need it in *world* coordinates, not widget pixels, so that a point placed at 8× zoom lands where the same point placed at 1× does.
records.translation: दो सुविधाओं को क्लिक का अर्थ "select the object under the cursor" (cursor के नीचे का ऑब्जेक्ट चुनें) के अलावा कुछ और चाहिए — polygon vertex बनाना (:mod:`spacr.qt.roi_tool`) और गिना गया marker रखना (:mod:`spacr.qt.counting_tool`) — और दोनों को यह widget पिक्सेल में नहीं, *world* निर्देशांकों में चाहिए, ताकि 8× zoom पर रखा गया बिंदु वहीं पड़े जहाँ 1× पर रखा गया वही बिंदु पड़ता है।

records.context: What turns a drag into ONE action. records.context: Run this on a worker. ``os.stat`` and ``shutil.disk_usage`` are the calls that wake a sleeping automount, and no cache can answer them without inventing the numbers, so the Qt caller hands this whole function to a :class:`~spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner` (:func:`spacr.qt.preferences._start_disk_report`). records.context: ``release_models=False``. Releasing a model the processing session is about to reload is a slowdown dressed as an optimisation — the reclaim is temporary, the reload is seconds of disk and PCIe, and the peak memory is the same either way. ``empty_cache()`` still runs, because returning *reserved but unused* blocks is exactly what a processing session about to allocate wants.

records.context: :data:`TARGET_SKY_PERCENTILE` exposes the frame so that *empty sky* — not the mean — lands on :data:`TARGET_SKY_LUMA`, deliberately, so that a sun stays blown out instead of dragging the whole frame to black. Taken as a statement about one global exposure that is now flatly incompatible with the limit, and both of the obvious ways to force it are ruined pictures. Re-solving the exposure, or dimming the finished frame with :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.solve_dim`, needs a factor of 0.064-0.108; both take the sky's own 40th percentile from 0.00091 to 0.00000, i.e. every faint star and the whole nebula go to pure black, and the peak pixel falls from 236-252 to 67-90. Measured, rendered and looked at: a dark grey smudge.

records.translation: :data:`TARGET_SKY_PERCENTILE` फ़्रेम का exposure इस तरह तय करता है कि औसत नहीं, बल्कि *empty sky* :data:`TARGET_SKY_LUMA` पर आए; ऐसा जानबूझकर किया जाता है ताकि सूर्य पूरे फ़्रेम को काला करने के बजाय अत्यधिक चमकीला ही रहे। एक वैश्विक exposure के कथन के रूप में यह अब सीमा से सीधे असंगत है, और इसे लागू करने के दोनों स्पष्ट तरीके तस्वीर बिगाड़ देते हैं। exposure फिर से हल करने, या तैयार फ़्रेम को :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.solve_dim` से मंद करने के लिए 0.064-0.108 का गुणक चाहिए; दोनों आकाश के अपने 40वें percentile को 0.00091 से 0.00000 कर देते हैं, यानी हर धुँधला तारा और पूरी nebula शुद्ध काले हो जाते हैं, और शिखर पिक्सेल 236-252 से गिरकर 67-90 हो जाता है। मापा, रेंडर किया और देखा गया: एक गहरा धूसर धब्बा।

records.context: The reconciliation is that the two rules are about different things. The exposure anchor is about a *pixel with nothing in it*; the WCAG limit is about the mean over a **region the size of a line of text** (:data:`spacr.qt.imagery.TEXT_WINDOW`), which is the point :mod:`spacr.qt.imagery` already makes about photographs — every photograph has a white pixel somewhere and it is a bright *patch* that makes a caption unreadable. A 3 px star inside a 202x48 px text window moves that window's mean by a quarter of one per cent; the whole starfield measured on its own comes to 0.0007-0.0067, i.e. 1-11 % of the limit. A 207 px sun disc fills the window completely and cannot.

records.source: The reconciliation is that the two rules are about different things. The exposure anchor is about a *pixel with nothing in it*; the WCAG limit is about the mean over a **region the size of a line of text** (:data:`spacr.qt.imagery.TEXT_WINDOW`), which is the point :mod:`spacr.qt.imagery` already makes about photographs — every photograph has a white pixel somewhere and it is a bright *patch* that makes a caption unreadable. A 3 px star inside a 202x48 px text window moves that window's mean by a quarter of one per cent; the whole starfield measured on its own comes to 0.0007-0.0067, i.e. 1-11 % of the limit. A 207 px sun disc fills the window completely and cannot.
records.translation: सामंजस्य यह है कि दोनों नियम अलग-अलग चीज़ों के बारे में हैं। exposure anchor *pixel with nothing in it* के बारे में है; WCAG सीमा **region the size of a line of text** (:data:`spacr.qt.imagery.TEXT_WINDOW`) पर औसत के बारे में है, और यही बात :mod:`spacr.qt.imagery` तस्वीरों के बारे में पहले से कहता है — हर तस्वीर में कहीं न कहीं एक सफ़ेद पिक्सेल होता है, और caption को अपठनीय बनाने वाला चमकीला *patch* होता है। 202x48 px पाठ विंडो के भीतर 3 px का तारा उस विंडो का औसत एक प्रतिशत के चौथाई भाग से बदलता है; पूरा starfield अकेले मापने पर 0.0007-0.0067 आता है, यानी सीमा का 1-11 %। 207 px की सूर्य-डिस्क विंडो को पूरी तरह भर देती है और सीमा में नहीं रह सकती।

records.context: So the exposure anchor is kept exactly as it was — the sky background is unchanged, to the byte — and the limit is enforced where it is actually violated, by compressing the highlights of the **smooth** layers only (:func:`_compress_highlights`, applied to nebula + galaxy + sun + bloom, never to the starfield). The sun therefore does get noticeably darker, which is the accepted cost; the galaxy is barely touched because it was never the offender; the stars keep white cores and diffraction spikes. :func:`_enforce_legibility` then measures the finished frame with the same :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.brightest_window` used on the photographs and applies whatever residual dim is left, so the guarantee is a measurement and not an argument.
records.label: spacr.qt.space#17
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: So the exposure anchor is kept exactly as it was — the sky background is unchanged, to the byte — and the limit is enforced where it is actually violated, by compressing the highlights of the **smooth** layers only (:func:`_compress_highlights`, applied to nebula + galaxy + sun + bloom, never to the starfield). The sun therefore does get noticeably darker, which is the accepted cost; the galaxy is barely touched because it was never the offender; the stars keep white cores and diffraction spikes. :func:`_enforce_legibility` then measures the finished frame with the same :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.brightest_window` used on the photographs and applies whatever residual dim is left, so the guarantee is a measurement and not an argument.
records.translation: इसलिए exposure anchor ठीक वैसा ही रखा गया है — आकाश की पृष्ठभूमि byte तक अपरिवर्तित है — और सीमा वहीं लागू की जाती है जहाँ वह वास्तव में टूटती है, केवल **smooth** layers के highlights संपीड़ित करके (:func:`_compress_highlights`, जो nebula + galaxy + sun + bloom पर लागू होता है, starfield पर कभी नहीं)। इसलिए सूर्य स्पष्ट रूप से गहरा हो जाता है, जो स्वीकृत कीमत है; galaxy को मुश्किल से छुआ जाता है क्योंकि वह कभी दोषी नहीं थी; तारे सफ़ेद cores और diffraction spikes बनाए रखते हैं। फिर :func:`_enforce_legibility` तस्वीरों पर उपयोग होने वाले उसी :func:`spacr.qt.imagery.brightest_window` से तैयार फ़्रेम मापता है और जो भी शेष dim बचा हो उसे लागू करता है, इसलिए गारंटी एक माप है, तर्क नहीं।

records.source: ``inf`` when there is nothing to solve for — a palette that admits no wallpaper at all (:func:`spacr.qt.theme.max_background_luma` is *negative* for the light theme) or a zero exposure. records.context: It must not disappear while the pointer moves toward it. The pointer has to cross the gap between the row and the panel, and a plain leave-event dismissal closes it mid-journey, which makes the Install link unreachable. The hide is a timer, the timer is cancelled on entry, and while it is pending the cursor is checked against the corridor -- the union of the anchor's rectangle and the panel's -- so travelling through the gap re-arms the timer instead of firing it. See :meth:`AvailabilityPanel. _maybe_hide`.

records.context: The default statistic is the area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUC), computed from the Mann–Whitney U statistic. Results are reported as the unit-free separation ``|2·AUC − 1|`` in ``[0, 1]`` together with the direction of the class difference. AUC is rank based and therefore invariant under monotonic transformations; it does not require normality, equal variance or symmetry. These properties allow measurements with different units and distributions to be compared in one ranking.

records.source: The default statistic is the area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUC), computed from the Mann–Whitney U statistic. Results are reported as the unit-free separation ``|2·AUC − 1|`` in ``[0, 1]`` together with the direction of the class difference. AUC is rank based and therefore invariant under monotonic transformations; it does not require normality, equal variance or symmetry. These properties allow measurements with different units and distributions to be compared in one ranking.
records.translation: डिफ़ॉल्ट statistic receiver-operating-characteristic curve के नीचे का क्षेत्रफल (AUC) है, जिसकी गणना Mann–Whitney U statistic से की जाती है। परिणाम इकाई-रहित पृथक्करण ``|2·AUC − 1|`` के रूप में ``[0, 1]`` में, वर्ग-अंतर की दिशा के साथ, बताए जाते हैं। AUC rank पर आधारित है और इसलिए monotonic रूपांतरणों के अंतर्गत अपरिवर्तित रहता है; इसके लिए normality, समान variance या symmetry आवश्यक नहीं है। इन गुणों के कारण अलग-अलग इकाइयों और वितरणों वाले मापों की तुलना एक ही क्रम में की जा सकती है।

records.context: AUC represents the probability that a randomly selected object from one class has a higher value than a randomly selected object from the other class. It detects stochastic ordering but can miss distribution-shape differences. For example, classes with the same centre but different spread can have an AUC of 0.5 despite differing distributions. The Kolmogorov–Smirnov (KS) statistic is therefore computed for every feature. A high KS statistic combined with AUC near 0.5 sets :attr:`FeatureScore.is_shape_not_shift`.

records.context: :attr:`ExplorerSpec.n_permutations` enables a family-wise permutation calibration. Class labels are permuted, the complete ranking is recomputed and the maximum score from each permutation is retained. The 95th percentile of these maxima is returned as :attr:`ExplorerResult.null_threshold`. Calibration uses a seeded subsample of at most :data:`NULL_MAX_ROWS` rows and is disabled by default because computation scales with the number of permutations.

records.source: Returns True once the PNG — the raster the GUI actually displays — is on disk. A failed *sibling PDF* does not turn that into False, and the asymmetry is deliberate rather than sloppy: the callers turn False into "no pixmap, no thumbnail", so reporting a missing export that way would delete the figure from the gallery over a file nothing has asked for yet. It is logged at WARNING instead, and :meth:`FigureQueue._request_pdf_refinement` notices the absent page, says so, and stops waiting for a render that will never arrive.
records.translation: PNG — वह raster जिसे GUI वास्तव में दिखाता है — disk पर पहुँचते ही True लौटाता है। विफल *sibling PDF* इसे False में नहीं बदलता, और यह असमानता लापरवाही नहीं, जानबूझकर है: कॉलर False को "no pixmap, no thumbnail" (कोई pixmap नहीं, कोई thumbnail नहीं) में बदलते हैं, इसलिए गायब export को इस तरह रिपोर्ट करने से उस फ़ाइल के कारण gallery से figure हट जाता जिसे अभी तक किसी ने माँगा भी नहीं। इसके बजाय इसे WARNING स्तर पर लॉग किया जाता है, और :meth:`FigureQueue._request_pdf_refinement` अनुपस्थित page को पहचानता है, यह बताता है, और कभी न आने वाले render की प्रतीक्षा बंद कर देता है।

records.source: That distinction is not cosmetic. ``grna_csv``, ``row_csv`` and ``column_csv`` are declared ``str`` and go straight to ``pd.read_csv``, so rendering them as a list turned a working default into ``['/path/to/barcodes_row.csv']`` the moment the screen was opened and saved. Every run from that file was then refused by the pre-flight -- "column_csv=[...] is a list, but str is expected" -- against a value the user had never typed and could not correct from the panel that wrote it.
records.translation: यह भेद केवल दिखावटी नहीं है। ``grna_csv``, ``row_csv`` और ``column_csv`` ``str`` घोषित हैं और सीधे ``pd.read_csv`` में जाते हैं, इसलिए उन्हें सूची के रूप में रेंडर करने से स्क्रीन खोलकर सहेजते ही एक काम करता डिफ़ॉल्ट ``['/path/to/barcodes_row.csv']`` बन गया। फिर उस फ़ाइल से हर run को pre-flight ने अस्वीकार कर दिया -- "column_csv=[...] is a list, but str is expected" -- ऐसे मान के विरुद्ध जिसे उपयोगकर्ता ने कभी टाइप नहीं किया था और जिसे लिखने वाले panel से ठीक नहीं कर सकता था।

records.context: **The whole table, never the filtered view.** ``zscore(area)`` computed over whatever the Local Data Filter currently shows would change every time a slider moved, so the column would not be stable: two charts drawn a second apart would disagree, and an exported CSV would record one arbitrary moment. records.context: Two rules apply to what the preview reports.

records.source: Two rules apply to what the preview reports.
records.translation: preview जो रिपोर्ट करता है उस पर दो नियम लागू होते हैं।

records.context: **Units.** The assay converts pixels per frame into physical units with ``factor = (1 / pixels_per_um) * (60 / seconds_per_frame)`` and only when *both* are known; otherwise it reports ``px/frame``. So that a velocity is never read in the wrong unit, the calibration fields start **unset**, every velocity carries its unit, and while the calibration is unknown the panel says so in words instead of silently using the 1.78 px/µm default.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.motility_preview#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Units.** The assay converts pixels per frame into physical units with ``factor = (1 / pixels_per_um) * (60 / seconds_per_frame)`` and only when *both* are known; otherwise it reports ``px/frame``. So that a velocity is never read in the wrong unit, the calibration fields start **unset**, every velocity carries its unit, and while the calibration is unknown the panel says so in words instead of silently using the 1.78 px/µm default.
records.translation: **Units.** assay pixels per frame को ``factor = (1 / pixels_per_um) * (60 / seconds_per_frame)`` से भौतिक इकाइयों में बदलता है, और केवल तब जब *both* ज्ञात हों; अन्यथा यह ``px/frame`` रिपोर्ट करता है। ताकि velocity कभी गलत इकाई में न पढ़ी जाए, calibration फ़ील्ड **unset** से शुरू होते हैं, हर velocity अपनी इकाई साथ रखती है, और calibration अज्ञात रहते panel चुपचाप 1.78 px/µm डिफ़ॉल्ट उपयोग करने के बजाय शब्दों में यही बताता है।

records.context: **Short tracks.** Mean step length and straightness are unstable on a three-point track — straightness is exactly 1.0 for any two-point track, whatever the cell did. So the track-length distribution is drawn beside the velocity plot with the cutoff marked, and the minimum length is a live setting that decides which tracks enter the velocity and straightness numbers.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.motility_preview#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Short tracks.** Mean step length and straightness are unstable on a three-point track — straightness is exactly 1.0 for any two-point track, whatever the cell did. So the track-length distribution is drawn beside the velocity plot with the cutoff marked, and the minimum length is a live setting that decides which tracks enter the velocity and straightness numbers.
records.translation: **Short tracks.** तीन-बिंदु track पर औसत step लंबाई और straightness अस्थिर हैं — किसी भी दो-बिंदु track के लिए straightness ठीक 1.0 होती है, cell ने चाहे जो किया हो। इसलिए track-लंबाई वितरण velocity plot के बगल में cutoff चिह्नित करके बनाया जाता है, और न्यूनतम लंबाई एक live सेटिंग है जो तय करती है कि कौन-से tracks velocity और straightness संख्याओं में शामिल हों।

records.context: The expensive half (reading merged arrays and extracting centroids) runs once in a background execution unit and is **cached** as a point table. Every metric setting — minimum length, max displacement, straightness threshold, and both calibration fields — recomputes from that cached table on the main GUI execution path, instantly.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context

records.context: A PCA scores plot is a scatter of two continuous columns that a user wants to colour by ``gene``, facet by ``plateID``, and brush to pull a cluster into Annotate. That is the Graph Builder, exactly, with the two columns computed rather than measured. So :meth:`PCAResult.scores_frame <spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.scores_frame>` appends ``PC1…PCk`` to the source frame and :class:`PCAScoresCanvas` is a :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` subclass that draws arrows on top.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_view#3

records.source: A PCA scores plot is a scatter of two continuous columns that a user wants to colour by ``gene``, facet by ``plateID``, and brush to pull a cluster into Annotate. That is the Graph Builder, exactly, with the two columns computed rather than measured. So :meth:`PCAResult.scores_frame <spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.scores_frame>` appends ``PC1…PCk`` to the source frame and :class:`PCAScoresCanvas` is a :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` subclass that draws arrows on top.
records.translation: PCA scores plot दो continuous columns का scatter है जिसे उपयोगकर्ता ``gene`` के अनुसार रंगना, ``plateID`` के अनुसार facet करना, और किसी cluster को Annotate में ले जाने के लिए brush करना चाहता है। यह ठीक Graph Builder है, बस दोनों columns मापे नहीं बल्कि गणना किए जाते हैं। इसलिए :meth:`PCAResult.scores_frame <spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.PCAResult.scores_frame>` स्रोत frame में ``PC1…PCk`` जोड़ता है और :class:`PCAScoresCanvas` एक :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` उपवर्ग है जो ऊपर तीर बनाता है।

records.context: Everything that took work in the Graph Builder therefore already works here and cannot drift out of step with it: the shared-scale facet grid, the fixed categorical colour order, the large-data policy and its notice, the selection-dims-never-hides rule, and the brush. Because the scores frame carries the object identifier columns, a rectangle dragged around a cluster in PC space publishes a real :class:`~spacr.selection.Selection`, and the UMAP, the laboratory microplate map and the extracted-image-region grid highlight the same cells. Reimplementing a scatter here would have meant reimplementing all of that and getting the brush subtly wrong.

records.context: Rows and columns are the **cartesian product** of their structured-data names' levels, empty combinations included, exactly as :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_spec.facet_grid` draws empty panels: a table read by position needs its positions to line up, and one that closes up its gaps tells the reader "there is no row H" when the truth is "row H was measured and is empty". Above :data:`MAX_ROWS` × :data:`MAX_COLS` the product is abandoned for the observed combinations only, and :attr:`PivotResult.notice` says so — an unreadable table is not more honest than a smaller one that admits what it left out.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pivot_spec#10
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Rows and columns are the **cartesian product** of their keys' levels, empty combinations included, exactly as :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_spec.facet_grid` draws empty panels: a table read by position needs its positions to line up, and one that closes up its gaps tells the reader "there is no row H" when the truth is "row H was measured and is empty". Above :data:`MAX_ROWS` × :data:`MAX_COLS` the product is abandoned for the observed combinations only, and :attr:`PivotResult.notice` says so — an unreadable table is not more honest than a smaller one that admits what it left out.
records.translation: rows और columns उनकी keys के levels का **cartesian product** हैं, खाली संयोजनों सहित, ठीक वैसे जैसे :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_spec.facet_grid` खाली panels बनाता है: स्थिति से पढ़ी जाने वाली तालिका की स्थितियाँ मेल खानी चाहिए, और जो तालिका अपने अंतराल बंद कर दे वह पाठक को "there is no row H" (कोई row H नहीं है) बताती है जबकि सच "row H was measured and is empty" (row H मापी गई और खाली है) है। :data:`MAX_ROWS` × :data:`MAX_COLS` से ऊपर product को छोड़कर केवल देखे गए संयोजन रखे जाते हैं, और :attr:`PivotResult.notice` यही बताता है — अपठनीय तालिका उस छोटी तालिका से अधिक ईमानदार नहीं है जो बताती है कि उसने क्या छोड़ा।

records.context: Every cell of a :class:`PivotResult` carries its **n**, whether or not the user ticked it, and the panel prints it. records.context: Three of those rows were bugs rather than differences of taste. Measure returned after extracting image regions again without a word when no array was loaded, so the button did nothing and said nothing. Timelapse and Motility wired ``QThread.finished`` to ``worker.deleteLater`` and dropped their own reference in the result slot — the pattern :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` documents as a race, and the one the Mask panel had already been fixed away from — which leaves a running ``QThread`` owned by nobody when the user closes the application view mid-pass. And Measure never told anyone its pass had landed, so no application view could react to an extracted image region preview the way it reacts to the other three.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.preview_contract#56
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three of those rows were bugs rather than differences of taste. Measure returned from its re-crop without a word when no array was loaded, so the button did nothing and said nothing. Timelapse and Motility wired ``QThread.finished`` to ``worker.deleteLater`` and dropped their own reference in the result slot — the pattern :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` documents as a race, and the one the Mask panel had already been fixed away from — which leaves a running ``QThread`` owned by nobody when the user closes the screen mid-pass. And Measure never told anyone its pass had landed, so no screen could react to a crop preview the way it reacts to the other three.
records.translation: उनमें से तीन पंक्तियाँ रुचि के अंतर नहीं, bugs थीं। कोई array लोड न होने पर Measure अपने re-crop से बिना कुछ कहे लौट जाता था, इसलिए बटन ने न कुछ किया न कुछ कहा। Timelapse और Motility ने ``QThread.finished`` को ``worker.deleteLater`` से जोड़ा और result slot में अपना संदर्भ छोड़ दिया — वही pattern जिसे :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` एक race के रूप में प्रलेखित करता है, और जिससे Mask panel पहले ही ठीक किया जा चुका था — इससे उपयोगकर्ता के pass के बीच स्क्रीन बंद करने पर एक चलता हुआ ``QThread`` बिना किसी स्वामी के रह जाता है। और Measure ने कभी किसी को नहीं बताया कि उसका pass पूरा हो गया, इसलिए कोई स्क्रीन crop preview पर वैसी प्रतिक्रिया नहीं दे सकती थी जैसी अन्य तीन पर देती है।

records.context: **Cancel** and **Stop** are also different words. A live view's Cancel throws the pass away: nothing it produced is kept, because a half -segmented field is not a result. A hyperparameter search's Stop (:class:`spacr.qt.screens.hyperparam.HyperparamPanel`) finishes the trial in flight and keeps every trial already scored, marking the result partial. Same button position, deliberately different verbs, because a user who presses one expecting the other loses either nothing or hours.

records.source: ``model_type=`` is accepted and ignored by Cellpose 4 — it logs "not used in v4.0.1+" and drops it, leaving ``pretrained_model`` at its ``cpsam`` default. Passing the user's choice there therefore segmented with ``cpsam`` whatever they picked, including a checkpoint they had just trained in spaCR's own Train Cellpose module. :func:`spacr.utils._resolve_cellpose_pretrained` is what the pipeline uses: it maps the legacy pre-SAM names onto ``cpsam`` and says so once, and returns a path unchanged when the name is a fine-tuned checkpoint.
records.translation: Cellpose 4 ``model_type=`` स्वीकार करके अनदेखा कर देता है — यह "not used in v4.0.1+" लॉग करता है और उसे छोड़ देता है, ``pretrained_model`` को उसके ``cpsam`` डिफ़ॉल्ट पर रहने देता है। इसलिए वहाँ उपयोगकर्ता की पसंद देने से segmentation ``cpsam`` से ही होता था, उन्होंने जो भी चुना हो, spaCR के अपने Train Cellpose मॉड्यूल में अभी train किया गया checkpoint भी। :func:`spacr.utils._resolve_cellpose_pretrained` वही है जो pipeline उपयोग करती है: यह पुराने pre-SAM नामों को ``cpsam`` पर map करता है और एक बार यह बताता है, और जब नाम fine-tuned checkpoint हो तो पथ को अपरिवर्तित लौटाता है।

records.context: Nothing on this tab touches a processing-session folder from the main GUI execution path. On one workstation a single ``os.path.exists`` on a path under ``/nas_mnt`` -- an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep -- did not return within twenty seconds. Every row here carries a folder the user chose, so walking, stat-ing, reading and deleting those folders (the sweep table read on a tab change, ``describe_folder``'s ``os.walk`` inside the delete confirmation, ``shutil.rmtree`` after it, and ``workspace.has_workspace`` while the row menu is built) run on a :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`. The one remaining existence check -- which folder to open the chooser in -- is answered from :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`'s cache.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.sweep_runs#3
